name: Harigaya Hisato
source: A second-year at Mihashi High School and the taciturn of its Stride Club. Was forced to join the club by [url=/c43018]Nagatsuka[/url]. Hisato often tends to be by himself and stay off from the crowds, but also has a secret hobby of DJing, which surprises most people.
